name: Wisewin Innotech Group Limited
summary: GC Construction Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, operates as a wet trades contractor in Hong Kong. The company undertakes plastering, tile laying, brick laying, floor screeding, and marble works for public or private residential and commercial properties. The company was formerly known as Chan Kiu Engineering Holdings Limited. GC Construction Holdings Limited was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Kowloon, Hong Kong.
